controlled_vocabulary_source.notes: Canonical bounded-value source for validators that enforce shared controlled vocabularies.

schemas.name: logos_node_min
schemas.notes: Minimal frontmatter-oriented validation for governed content-node documents. Governance addenda, roadmap notes, and other non-node authored records remain outside this contract until dedicated schemas exist.

schemas.name: logos_claim_min
schemas.notes: Minimal validation for governed claim objects.

schemas.name: logos_external_mapping_object
schemas.notes: Canonical contract for governed external mapping objects. The dedicated validator resolves canonical targets from real graph objects, excludes example fixtures and templates, and enforces external-handle boundaries.

schemas.name: doctrine_genealogy_date_block_v1
schemas.notes: Kernel A4 shared date discipline for future doctrine-genealogy schemas; draft, non-authorizing, and not yet wired to a data validator.

schemas.name: doctrine_provenance_v1
schemas.notes: Kernel C1 provenance block, field-for-field; draft, non-authorizing, and reserved for PR-4 validator implementation.

schemas.name: doctrine_genealogy_node_v1
schemas.notes: Kernel A2 schema for the eight doctrine-genealogy node types; no doctrine data records are introduced by this registry entry.

schemas.name: genealogy_edge_v1
schemas.notes: Kernel A3 genealogy edge schema with the approved verb registry and forbidden-verb guardrails; no edges are introduced by this registry entry.

schemas.name: evidence_packet_v1
schemas.notes: Kernel D1 evidence packet schema for derived, read-only cross-repo reports; no evidence packets are introduced by this registry entry.

schemas.name: llos_lesson_v1
schemas.notes: D11 LLOS v1 lesson contract. Candidate lessons remain non-authorizing and may cross to DAD only as allowlisted metadata.
